candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Working Student (f/m/d) – Cloud Developer for SAP Document AI
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position as Cloud Developer for automated document processing. Automating work with documents using machine learning and large language models is close to my latest project: a Python service that reads PDF documents and answers questions about them with page-level citations.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence and four SAP Certified Associate certifications. I was one of 10 participants from Pakistan selected for the SAP Young Professionals Program.

achievements.impact: I built DocuMind (github.com/Rayyan3079/documind-rag): PDF ingestion and chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval and answers from the Claude API; 91% correct on a 22-question test set
it runs as a FastAPI REST API and a Streamlit UI, with 37 offline unit tests, GitHub Actions CI and Docker
I worked hands-on with SAP Analytics Cloud, Datasphere and S/4HANA Cloud, and studied SAP Cloud Integration in the YPP

letter.problems_section: I would help develop and test cloud services for document processing, integrate machine learning and LLM-based models and work on improving matching accuracy. I have not built TypeScript UIs yet; with my Python and API experience I would learn your UI stack quickly.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to the Walldorf area and can work up to 20 hours per week, starting immediately. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
